_not: Sefer tutorial'ı (Ömer 2026-10-13 onayı; 2026-10-14 durum dersleri; tasarım docs/design/tutorial.md). Metinler oyun içi (İngilizce), her ders en çok 1-2 cümle. Mentor kutusu src/ui/lesson-box.ts, kurallar (saf) src/tutorial/lessons.ts + durum tespiti src/tutorial/situations.ts, kayıt localStorage proto.tutorial.v1 (src/tutorial/store.ts). İlk savaş (Mill Road) adım adım zorunlu: forced = next (düğme) | skill (temel saldırı düğmesi) | target (hedef seçilip saldırı yapılınca), trigger.battle {node:[1], when:start}. Sonraki TÜM savaş dersleri DURUMLA tetiklenir (trigger.battle.when; düğüm/bölge yok): durum ilk kez oluştuğunda, sırası gelen kahraman için, o an kullanılacak düğmeyi gösterir. when: first (Mill Road sonrası savaşın ilk kararı), rest (MP'li skill'lerin hiçbiri MP yetmediği için kullanılamıyor), move (yakın dövüş hiçbir düşmana ulaşamıyor), skip (hiçbir skill kullanılamıyor, Rest/Move çözüm değil), ultimate (4. skill hazır), spent (kullanılan skill beklemede ya da MP harcandı), status (kahramanda durum), ground (kahramanın hücresinde / yanında zararlı zemin), telegraph (boss vuruş hücrelerini işaretledi), fallen (oyuncunun bir kahramanı düştü; Valor açıksa variants.valor metni), preview (düşmana hasar veren skill seçildi), ally (dost seçen skill seçildi), reach (seçilen yakın dövüş skill'i arka sıradaki düşmana ulaşamıyor), area (alan skill'i seçildi). Veri sırası = öncelik; kararda en çok bir ders. done = eylem dersi (rest | move | skip | ultimate): oyuncu o eylemi yapınca tamamlanır, yapmazsa durum yeniden oluşunca (savaş başına bir kez, en çok actionRepeats savaş) yeniden çıkar; done yoksa bilgi dersi (bir kez). focus içindeki {skill} durumun skill'iyle değişir. Durum hiç oluşmazsa ders çıkmaz ve Codex > Lessons'ta da görünmez. trigger.screen: ekran dersleri (town, merchant, company, map, event, gear, endless, valor, rest); ek koşullar minWins (sefer zaferi), visible (haritada görünen düğüm türü), anyRarity (torbada / takılı nadirlik), bag (torbada item). Ekranda aynı anda tek ders. Metinde {victoryHeal} / {restHeal}: data/campaign/campaign.json yüzdeleri (src/tutorial/lessons.ts > LESSON_VARS). decision: zorunlu adımın kaçıncı oyuncu kararı (f_mp_skill = 2: en güçlü MP skill). spotlight: ekran kararır, yalnızca odak aydınlık (zorunlu adımlar, Boss). codex: Codex > Lessons metni (yoksa text). place: bottom = kutu altta (Gear). trigger.gate: formation = Zorunlu Formation kapısı (katılımdan sonra sıradaki savaşa dokununca; CampaignMapScene, awaitText = düğme yerine bekleme yazısı, Formation açılınca kapanır). defeatHints: Bölüm III'te aynı savaş 2 kez kaybedilince savaş başında mentor ipucu (Codex'e girmez).

opening.text: Thugs on the mill road, and only you between them and the village. Steady now. I'll talk you through it.

_actionRepeats: Eylem dersi (done) tamamlanmadan en çok kaç savaşta gösterilir.

lessons.title: The Turn Bar
lessons.text: The bar at the top shows who acts next. Faster fighters act more often.

lessons.title: Attacking
lessons.text: This is your attack. Press it.
lessons.codex: Your first skill is your basic attack. It costs nothing: pick it, then pick a target.

lessons.title: Choosing a Target
lessons.text: Now tap a glowing enemy to strike.
lessons.codex: After you pick a skill, the enemies it can reach glow. Hover one to preview the damage, tap it to strike.

lessons.title: Stronger Skills
lessons.text: Now your stronger skill. It costs MP and needs a few turns to return.
lessons.codex: Stronger skills cost MP and need a few turns before you can use them again.

lessons.title: Reading a Fighter
lessons.text: Tap or hover over any fighter to read their stats, passive and cooldowns.

lessons.title: Rest
lessons.text: Not enough MP for your stronger skills. Rest refills MP and ends the turn.

lessons.title: Move
lessons.text: Your melee attacks cannot reach from here. Move steps to an empty cell, then attack next turn.

lessons.title: Burning Ground
lessons.text: Burning ground hurts whoever stands on it when their turn begins. Move steps clear of it.

lessons.title: Skip Turn
lessons.text: Nothing useful to do this turn. Skip passes it and brings your next turn sooner.

lessons.title: The Ultimate
lessons.text: Your ultimate is ready: the strongest skill you have. Use it now.

lessons.title: Fallen Heroes
lessons.text: A fallen hero stays down after the battle. Towns and rest camps can raise them.

variants.valor: A fallen hero stays down after the battle. Towns, rest camps and Valor can raise them.

lessons.title: Skills and MP
lessons.text: Stronger skills cost MP, which refills a little each turn. A used skill may rest for a few turns.

lessons.title: Hit Chance
lessons.text: Before you strike, the numbers over a target show the damage and the chance to hit.

lessons.title: Helping Allies
lessons.text: Healing and blessings go to your own side. Tap a glowing ally.

lessons.title: Rows and Reach
lessons.text: Melee attacks reach only the front row. Ranged attacks and spells hit any row.

lessons.title: Area Shapes
lessons.text: Area skills hit a fixed shape of cells. The lit cells show exactly who gets caught.

lessons.title: Statuses
lessons.text: Icons beside a health bar are statuses, like Slow or Wound. Tap the unit to read what they do.

lessons.title: Bosses
lessons.text: The marked cells are struck next: move out before the blow lands. Stuns and slows do not work on bosses.

pages.text: Drag an item from the bag onto a hero or one of their slots to equip it.
Hover or select an item: the stats show how that hero would change before you commit.
In a hurry? Equip best picks the strongest items for the whole company.

lessons.title: Item Quality
lessons.text: The colour shows an item’s quality. Each step up adds a line: Uncommon a second C, Rare a B, Epic an A.

lessons.title: Towns
lessons.text: Towns heal your company and raise the fallen. Tap a place in the village to use it; the road out moves on.

lessons.title: Your Company
lessons.text: Choose the heroes who carry the fight north. The first one you pick leads the company and always fights.

lessons.title: The Merchant
lessons.text: Odo buys and sells gear. Selling what you will not use frees room in the bag.

lessons.title: Wounds Carry Over
lessons.text: Wounds carry over between battles. A victory restores only {victoryHeal}% of each hero’s health.

lessons.title: Reading the Road
lessons.text: A horned helm marks an elite fight, a crowned skull a boss, a campfire a rest camp and a chest treasure. Read the road before you choose it.

lessons.title: Rest Camps
lessons.text: Resting here is free: every living hero recovers {restHeal}% of their health. The fallen can be raised here for gold.

lessons.title: A New Companion
lessons.text: A new hero has joined, so set your formation before the next fight. Drag heroes into cells: the front row takes the hits, the back row keeps archers and casters safer.

lessons.title: Formation
lessons.text: Open Formation to place your heroes. The front row takes the melee blows; keep the frail ones behind.

lessons.title: Roads
lessons.text: You can now travel back along cleared roads. Patrols return to cleared battlefields.

lessons.title: Valor
lessons.text: Victories earn Valor. Spend it to raise a fallen hero, in battle or on the map.

lessons.title: Choices
lessons.text: Every choice here has a price: gold, health or a fight. The line under each option says exactly what it does.

pages.title: Waves
pages.text: Endless is wave after wave, each one harder. Wounds carry over from one wave to the next.

pages.title: Camp
pages.text: After each victory you choose one reward, then rest at camp: gear up and fight the next wave when ready.

pages.title: Relics
pages.text: Every boss leaves a relic. Its power stays with your company for the whole run.

defeatHints._not: Bölüm III: aynı savaş minDefeats kez kaybedilince savaş başında mentor ipucu (karşılaşma id'sine göre; yoksa default).

byEncounter.ashen_plain: The Ash Hounds leap past your front line and go for the wounded. Keep your heroes' HP up, and break the Grave Chanter's bones before you hit him.
byEncounter.siege_line: Soldiers standing side by side shield each other. Bring down one end of the line first, and poke the Stonebound Warden now and then so it never hardens.
byEncounter.thornwood_hollow: Below 40% HP the Drake Priest bursts and burns your whole team. Heal up first, then push him through it in one go.
byEncounter.ember_road: The Outriders flee and act early at half HP: finish them in one blow. The Ash Hound hunts your weakest hero.
byEncounter.riverhead: Every death feeds the Drowned and the Ghoul. Silence the Witchling's curses early and hit the Wisp with one heavy blow.
byEncounter.gate_of_cinders: The Gatewardens punish melee blows. Use spells and ranged attacks, and reach the Runecaller who shields them.
byEncounter.castle_morvane: Every guard that falls shields Morvane. Step out of the falling ash, and brace for the Pyre when he drops low: it covers your whole side.

defeatHints.default: Change the plan: put your sturdiest hero in front, keep healers behind, and strike the enemy's healer first.
